question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. 'Aggreement'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Aggreement"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "Agreement". (सहमति)

 
 
• **Example:** They finally reached an agreement after hours of negotiation.
 
 
 
• **"Agreement"** refers to a mutual arrangement, contract, or understanding between parties. (सहमति)
 
 
• **Example:** The two companies signed an agreement to cooperate on the new project.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Aggreement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Arbitrary** (मनमाना): Based on random choice or personal whim, rather than any reason or system.

 
 
• **Example:** The decision seemed arbitrary and was not based on any logical rationale.
 
 
 
• **Favourite** (पसंदीदा): Preferred to all others of the same kind.
 
 
• **Example:** Chocolate ice cream is my favourite dessert.
 
 
 
• **Conviction** (दोषसिद्धि): A firmly held belief or firmness of opinion.
 
 
• **Example:** His speech was delivered with great conviction and passion.
